components.name: Action-language precision and reachable boundary orbits
components.project_addition: Specialize P023 future-compatible quotient theory to integer translations with ordered threshold observations. Identify the coarsest finite-horizon precision cells with the orbit of observation boundaries under actually reachable cumulative translations; derive exact one-sided numerical-semigroup class counts, the equality between group-completion over-refinement and relevant semigroup holes, conductor-localized irregular precision, genuine two-sided group completion to gZ, and automatic subgroup completion under finite cyclic periodicization. Use the chain-versus-cycle distinction to reconcile E001 threshold/contact reachability with E002 centered cyclic gcd actuation. Generic quotient/minimization remains P023-owned; numerical-semigroup and group-theoretic ingredients are established prior mathematics.
